desc:
🥷 SHADOW BLADE ARENA 🥷

Step into an arena where every player is invisible — one wrong move, and you're exposed. Track your enemy by instinct, strike at the perfect moment, and disappear before they even know you were there.

⚡ Stay careless, get caught — every action can reveal your position
🗡️ Master your blade & shurikens — outsmart and outfight your rivals
🏆 Win duels, unlock rewards — earn cool new weapons & shurikens

👻 Silence is your greatest weapon. Are you Shadow Blade material?

Inspired by Silent Assassins
